newsitem.title: USA: Young Russian emigre charged in Cosby murder.
newsitem.headline: Young Russian emigre charged in Cosby murder.

text.p: An 18-year-old Russian emigre has been charged with murdering the only son of entertainer Bill Cosby, Los Angeles police chief Willie Williams said on Thursday.

He told reporters the man, Mikail Markhasev, had lived in the United States for the last eight years, but there was no indication that the Jan 16 killing was connected to any Russian organised crime group.
Williams said the murder weapon had been recovered along with a cap after a tip-off from a tabloid newspaper. Forensic tests showed the gun was the one that killed Ennis Cosby.
Cosby, 27, was gunned down in the early hours of Jan. 16 while changing a tire on his Mercedes car by the side of a freeway.
"It appears that robbery was the motive. It was happenstance," said Williams, who added all indications were that race was not a factor.
The suspect, who is white, was charged with one count of murder, said the police chief.
